name: @rbtv/office-document
description: Dependency manifest for the document component. ONE package manager (npm): md-to-pdf is the only element npm resolves, and it is this component's PDF engine (also pulls Puppeteer/Chromium for md and HTML-print rendering — deck PDF print reuses this same path; no second Chromium is declared next to design's Playwright). Python bits (python-docx, pyyaml — the DOCX engine) are HOST SYSTEM elements in rbtv.system. Declaration only; never published, never installed in place.

install.node: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
